import more_itertools as mi
import itertools

# Test combination_with_replacement_index
n = 5
r = 3
all_cwr = list(itertools.combinations_with_replacement(range(n), r))
for idx, elem in enumerate(all_cwr):
    computed = mi.combination_with_replacement_index(elem, range(n))
    assert computed == idx, f'Index {idx}: Expected {idx}, got {computed} for {elem}'
print('combination_with_replacement_index: All', len(all_cwr), 'tests passed')

    expected = all_cwr[idx]
    assert computed == expected, f'Index {idx}: Expected {expected}, got {computed}'
print('nth_combination_with_replacement: All', len(all_cwr), 'tests passed')
